The name Alini carries the meaning “Peaceful Wave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Alini usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
